# Security Policy

## Supported Scope

This policy applies to the public website source and related repository content.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report vulnerabilities privately:

- Email: security@cs-agency.com.au
- Fallback: info@cs-agency.com.au
- Security contact file: `https://cs-agency.com.au/.well-known/security.txt`

Include:

- Vulnerability summary and impact
- Affected path(s) or page(s)
- Reproduction steps or proof of concept
- Recommended remediation (if available)

## Disclosure Expectations

- Do not publish vulnerabilities before coordinated remediation.
- We will acknowledge receipt and triage as quickly as possible.
- We may request additional details to validate and resolve findings.
